key.name: omp-path
key.description: Absolute path. Empty uses ~/.bun/bin/omp (the Shell's PATH does not include it).

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to run `omp usage --json`. The timer never runs `omp usage invalidate`.

key.name: panel-display
key.description: Two stacked mini bars (5h / 7d of the primary account), the compact text, or both.

key.name: primary-account
key.summary: Account shown in the top bar
key.description: An account key such as anthropic:me@example.com, chosen by activating an account title in the menu. Empty selects the first account omp reports.
